jobs.occupation: Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Specialist | HQ
jobs.description:
Offering innovative hearing solutions to enable our customers to enjoy life to the fullest - that's our ambition. As number one on the Belgian market, we are constantly looking for talented and enthusiastic new colleagues.  Working at Sonova Retail Belgium means working in a company which is part of the world's leading manufacturer of hearing solutions, the Sonova Group. In more than 90 countries, our hearing solutions improve people's lives. A career with us has therefore no limits!

 

Your responsibilities as Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Specialist:

As Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Specialist, you are a key partner for the business, hiring managers and HR. You ensure a smooth and professional recruitment process while proactively building talent pipelines and strengthening our employer brand within the audiological and retail market.

You will be responsible for:
 
• Managing the end-to-end recruitment process from intake to onboarding: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate communication, selection support, offer follow-up and handover. 
• Partnering with hiring managers and the HR Business Partner to analyze recruitment needs and translate them into clear profiles and hiring strategies. 
• Developing and executing effective sourcing strategies via LinkedIn, job boards, social media, referrals, schools, universities and recruitment partners. 
• Building and maintaining talent pipelines and a structured talent community, with a focus on audiological profiles, retail talent and hard-to-fill positions, through proactive sourcing, hunting and talent pooling. 
• Nurturing relationships with potential candidates and engaging talent pools through targeted communication initiatives (e.g. newsletters and employer branding content). 
• Ensuring a positive, consistent and professional candidate experience throughout the entire recruitment process. 
• Coordinating audiology internships by aligning business needs, matching students with placements and ensuring follow-up with interns, supervisors and educational partners, including evaluations and feedback moments. 
• Supporting and strengthening campus recruitment initiatives through partnerships with schools and universities, student engagement and participation in events. 
• Coordinating student jobs by aligning with business needs and managing contacts with students and interim agencies, ensuring smooth planning, administration and onboarding. 
• Developing and maintaining strong partnerships with schools, universities, training institutes and external recruitment partners. 
• Planning and participating in recruitment events such as job fairs, campus events, presentations, speeddates and networking initiatives. 
• Contributing to employer branding and recruitment marketing by creating and coordinating engaging content across different channels in collaboration with HR, Marketing and Communications. 
• Monitoring recruitment performance and KPIs, analyzing results and continuously improving recruitment and sourcing strategies. 
• Acting as a true Sonova/Lapperre ambassador towards candidates and external partners. 

To be successful in this role, you will need:
 
• A master's degree in HR, Communication, Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent through experience. 
• Min. 5 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, employer branding or recruitment marketing. 
• Experience with end-to-end recruitment and proactive sourcing techniques. 
• Affinity with campus recruitment, internships or collaboration with schools and universities is a strong asset. 
• Fluency in Dutch, French and English. 
• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple processes and stakeholders simultaneously. 
• A proactive and hands-on mindset combined with creativity and strong communication skills. 
• Experience with LinkedIn, social media and recruitment tools. 
• A people-oriented, curious and positive attitude, with a strong team spirit and sense of ownership.

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Our Belgian SAP BI & Data team is made up of a dynamic and passionate group of individuals. With a collective experience ranging from 2 to +20 years, our colleagues have dedicated a significant portion of their careers to Capgemini, showing how much we love it here. From database migrations to data warehouses and dynamic reporting, we take it upon ourselves to maximize data-potential and empower our customers to extract the most value from their data.

Your role

As a Data Migration Expert (SAP), you'll be at the forefront of designing and executing data migration strategies that ensure smooth and efficient transitions across systems. Your role will be pivotal in overseeing data migration projects, from initial planning through to execution and validation. You'll ensure that data is accurately and securely transferred between systems, maintaining integrity and consistency throughout the process. Utilizing advanced tools like SAP migration cockpit and EMIGALL, you’ll streamline migration workflows and resolve any challenges that arise. If you’re passionate about orchestrating complex data migrations and want to lead in a cutting-edge environment, this position is for you.

Key tasks & activities

• You act as an experienced data migration consultant on data migration and data governance projects. You engage in a diverse range of activities, including delivery planning, data gathering, data cleansing and validation, development, testing, and execution of the migration.
• You interact with clients during workshops and trainings, forming the key link between customer requirements and technical solutions.
• You lead the implementation team, offering guidance and training to junior members while ensuring strict adherence to the project plan.
• You work closely with your project manager and the project team, but also with functional colleagues to create the best solution possible. You act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
• 
You provide support in proposals, product developments, and further research around Data Solutions

 

Knowledge & Experience

• You have a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in executing (SAP) migration projects, showcasing extensive analytical skills and technical knowledge on end-to-end migration lifecycles.
• You have acquired skills within:
• Data analysis: ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and quality of the migrated data by cleansing, transforming and validating data. This requires the use of data analysis languages such as SQL, and data analysis tools such as MS Excel or Access.
• Data migration: planning, executing and managing the migration of data from legacy systems to new target environments. This involves ensuring seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading processes, which requires proficiency in data migration tools such as S/4HANA migration cockpit, Emigall and/or LSMW. Knowledge of ETL tools as SAP Data services or Datasphere is a plus.
• Data migration planning: Strong team management skills are necessary to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams, ensuring that all members are aligned with project goals and timelines. This includes delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support, fostering a collaborative work environment, and managing stakeholder expectations.
• You possess knowledge on one or more of the main functional areas within a business, e.g., sales & distribution, purchasing, material management, financial management, and Human capital management.
• You are a proactive, results-driven team player with strong communication skills, a customer-oriented approach, and a consultancy mindset, capable of collaborating with diverse colleagues and confidently representing Capgemini to clients.
• Resident in Belgium.
• Fluent in Dutch/French and English.
• Geographic mobility. We serve customers throughout Belgium.
